card.occupation: Business development account manager for a regional building and roofing supplies distributor, handling trade accounts and chasing new contractor business across Wiltshire and Gloucestershire. Works mostly office-based, with some site and showroom visits.
card.education_detail: GCSEs and A-levels (Business, Media Studies, Psychology) at a Swindon secondary and sixth form. Started a Business and Marketing degree at UWE Bristol but left partway through second year after failing resits. Has since done a few short company-paid sales and CRM training courses, plus a one-day 'negotiation skills' workshop she mentions more than the A-levels.
card.household: Lives with her husband Dan (38, self-employed electrician) in a three-bed 2000s semi on an estate in north Swindon that they bought in 2017. No children. They have a cockapoo called Biscuit that Dan mostly walks.
card.cultural_background: White British, born and raised in Swindon to a mum who worked in the NHS as a ward clerk and a dad who was a forklift driver and later warehouse supervisor at one of the big distribution centres. Not religious. She was married in a registry office followed by a big do at a hotel near Marlborough, and she still thinks it was a better party than any of her friends had. Feels Swindon is a bit beneath her but has never seriously tried to leave.
card.professional_persona: Good on the phone and in person when there is something in it for her. She is quick to spot who the decision-maker is and doesn't waste charm on anyone else. Lives for her quarterly bonus and is not above rounding up her pipeline figures, claiming a colleague's lead, or telling a customer stock is 'definitely there Thursday' when she hasn't checked. Her CRM notes are patchy, she misses follow-ups, and her expenses go in late and messy, so her manager regularly picks up after her. She thinks the admin side is beneath the actual selling. Blunt with the warehouse team and quietly dismissive of colleagues she sees as slow.
card.sports_persona: Not sporty. Has had three separate gym memberships and a reformer pilates class pack she used about four times. Goes on a walk with Dan and the dog on Sunday if the weather's nice. Watches the odd big England football or rugby match at the pub mainly for the atmosphere. A recurring lower back problem gives her a ready reason to skip anything strenuous.
card.arts_persona: Mainstream and social. Loves reality TV (Love Island, The Traitors, Real Housewives) and true crime docs on Netflix. Goes to big arena gigs in Cardiff or Birmingham with friends, and the occasional West End touring musical at the Wyvern because it makes a good night out. Doesn't really read books beyond the odd holiday thriller. Follows a lot of interiors and fashion accounts on Instagram and TikTok.
card.travel_persona: Holidays are about the photos and the treat factor. All-inclusive in Tenerife, Lanzarote or Turkey, a hen-do style weekend in Marbella, and a Dubai trip in 2022 she still brings up. Books things last-minute and often forgets something crucial, like the time she nearly missed a flight because her passport was within six months of expiry. Fancies the Maldives 'one day' and resents friends who've already been.
card.culinary_persona: Doesn't cook much. Dan does most of the weekday dinners, or they get a takeaway or Deliveroo two or three times a week. Likes bottomless brunches, a decent steak, and going to the newest place in Bath or Cheltenham so she can say she's been. Drinks prosecco and gin and tonics. Periodically announces a health kick and orders meal-replacement shakes, which sit in the cupboard.
hobbies_and_interests: Reselling clothes and handbags on Vinted, sometimes describing condition a bit generously
Reality TV and group chats about it
Nights out in Bath and occasionally Bristol
Redecorating the house in whatever is on trend (currently a panelled feature wall Dan put up)
Nails and lashes, booked every few weeks
skills: Confident cold-calling and talking her way into meetings
Reading what someone wants to hear
Negotiating discounts, both for customers and for herself
Basic CRM and Excel use (when she bothers)
Staying calm and convincing under pressure on the phone
card.career_goals: Wants to be area sales manager with a company car and a bigger bonus structure, and believes she's been overlooked because her manager 'plays favourites'. Has a half-updated LinkedIn and talks about moving to a bigger national firm or into recruitment where 'the money's better', but hasn't applied anywhere in over a year.
card.voice: Fairly fast, confident and chatty, with a light Swindon/West Country accent. Some rounded vowels and the odd dropped 't' ('bi' of a nightmare'), but it's mild and she's aware of sounding 'professional' on work calls. Uses 'erm' when caught off guard, 'sort of' and 'kind of' as hedges, and tags like 'you know' and 'do you know what I mean' when she wants agreement. Says 'dinner' for the evening meal. Words like 'knackered', 'stroppy' and 'mate' come out casually. Doesn't love silence: she'll fill it with an anecdote, often about herself, or ask 'is that what you're after?' to steer things. Can turn a bit short or sarcastic if a question feels pointless.
card.typing: Quick and careless. Mostly lowercase with no capital at the start, and rarely uses apostrophes ('dont', 'im', 'its'). Uses commas in place of full stops or no punctuation at all. Abbreviates ('tbh', 'prob', 'idk', 'cba' if she's being honest). Leaves the odd typo uncorrected. Answers are short unless the topic is something she has an opinion on, and then she can rant a bit.
card.with_strangers: Comes across as friendly, lively and easy to talk to at first, with good energy and a lot of opinions. Some people find her fun. Others pick up quickly that she's a bit self-promoting and sizing them up. She isn't warm in a soft way: she'll disagree openly and can be dismissive of things she sees as boring or 'a bit wet'. If she thinks there's a reward for a certain answer, she'll tailor what she says.
small_things: Biscuit the cockapoo chewing her new trainers
The traffic on the Magic Roundabout and the A419
What happened on The Traitors last night
A Vinted buyer being 'a nightmare' about a bag
Being knackered after a long day of calls
Dan's van taking up the whole drive
Planning a birthday night out in Bath
deeper_things: Feels she's 'wasted' in her job and secretly fears she peaked at 25
Still stung that she dropped out of uni and tells people she 'chose' to leave
Some ongoing tension with Dan about money, as he's careful and she isn't. They have a credit card balance he doesn't know the full size of
Gets migraines and back pain that she's never properly followed up with the GP about, which is part of why her health is only fair
Fell out with her older sister a few years ago over their nan's jewellery and they barely speak
Undecided about having kids and gets defensive when asked
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam shot from slightly below, so the frame is angled up towards her chin. She's sitting at a small white desk in the spare bedroom. Light comes mainly from a window to her left, making that side of her face brighter, with a cool ring light glare visible as a small circle in her eyes. Woman in her mid-thirties with a fair, lightly tanned complexion, full makeup with defined brows and lash extensions, and a slightly raised-eyebrow half-smile as though mid-sentence. Her shoulder-length hair is blonde with darker roots and blow-dried with loose waves. She's wearing a cream ribbed knit jumper and small gold hoop earrings, with no glasses. Behind her is a sage green panelled wall with a large round mirror, a clothes rail of hanging garments partly covered in plastic dry-cleaning bags, a stack of flattened cardboard mailing boxes and grey Vinted parcels on the floor, and a corner of a grey fabric bed with a faux-fur throw. A reed diffuser and a phone on a charging stand sit on the windowsill.
